about: Rough performance of draft 03: how the lines are actually said, not how they're written. The script and the 'as written' recording are untouched; this sheet makes a separate recording. 'say' is what the voice reads (fillers, restarts, breaths as punctuation). 'gap' is seconds of silence before the line (negative jumps in on the last line). 'exaggeration' 0.25 flat .. 1.0 heightened; 'cfg' lower = looser, slower. 'text' must match the script line. 'extras' are sounds people make that aren't lines (laughs, breaths), placed after an action starts.
